entities.title: Rust crates
entities.summary: The validators for .dev files, ported from Python to Rust, and cyberspace-generator, the command-line tool built on them.
entities.purpose: Lets agents and CI check and maintain the .dev files the explorer shows, with one binary that needs no Python. cyberspace-common reads JSON strictly and walks a repository; cyberspace-diagrams and cyberspace-knowledge replace Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py and Meta/Agents/Knowledge/validate_knowledge.py; cyberspace-generator offers validate, scan and stale.
boundaries: The schemas are read at run time from the checked repository's Meta/Agents, never embedded.
The tool is released from generator-v* tags and installed as part of zazzle by the software-developers-toolbox repository; this repository does not publish it to Homebrew itself.
